caption: The drawing depicts a large, cylindrical stoneware jar with a slightly flared rim and two small, rounded handles attached near the top on opposite sides. The jar is rendered in shades of brown and tan, suggesting a glazed ceramic surface with areas of light and shadow, and several visible imperfections and cracks on its lower half. Just below the rim on the front of the jar, there is a blue decorative motif that is repeated on the back, as indicated by a note in the drawing. In the center of the motif, a label reads, “C. Crolius Stone-Ware Manufacturer Manhattan Wells New York.” The same label is reproduced in the upper right corner of the drawing. A small scale for measurement is depicted at the bottom left, and the artist's signature, “Chas. Coseau,” appears at the bottom right. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
